blast: low — three agent definitions under plugins/quill/agents/, against four suites already frozen at the spec gate. No spec.md, no .feature, and no published package is touched; @cyberplace/quill-plugin is private, so no changeset is owed. The quill project spec is already status: approved, so this mission's terminus is the impl gate.
approach: the contract is frozen and is not this mission's to change — if an agent cannot satisfy a scenario, that is a BLOCKER, never a suite edit
the impl-judge is ACED's (aced-impl-judge), not quill-judge — these are agent-configuration artifacts, so fixing quill-judge here does not mean it grades its own change
extend each load list, never replace it — the defect being fixed is exactly a replaced list
governances_loaded is already REQUIRED by spec-producer-governance, listed even when empty; this is not spec-ahead
